examples.text: 1914, Walther Kabel (as W. Belka), Die Versprengten, Verlag moderner Lektüre, page 8
examples.translation: The animal, pinched with the whole body between bricks and girts, now began to faintly whimper.
examples.english: The animal, pinched with the whole body between bricks and girts, now began to faintly whimper.

glosses: Gémir, pleurer, à petite voix, souvent de douleur.

examples.text: Sie fahren nicht wirklich schnell, ein Hund kreuzt die Straße, der Aufprall (...) Es ist ein grauhaariger Collie, der Zusammenstoß hat ihm den Brustkorb eingedrückt, sein Blut fließt über den Straßenrand, aber er ist nicht tot, er winselt, es hört sich an wie ein jammerndes Baby.
examples.translation: On ne roule pas si vite, un chien traverse la route, la secousse (...) C’est un colley au poil gris, le choc lui a défoncé le thorax, son sang s’écoule sur le bas-côté, mais il n’est pas mort, il geint, on dirait la plainte d’un bébé.

examples.text: „Beim Einschlag krümmt sich die Kreatur. Dann rollt sie sich zappelnd auf alle viere und kriecht mit einem dünnen Winseln von ihr weg.“
„Fast klingt es wie ein menschlicher Schrei. Fast. Ein kurzes Schmerzgebrüll und dann ein langgezogenes Winseln, das vom heulenden Wind verschluckt wird.“

glosses: fiepende, jammernde, leise Töne des Unbehagens von sich geben

examples.text: Der Hund liegt angekettet vor seiner Hundehütte und winselt leise vor sich hin.
Bello winselte, um wieder ins Haus gelassen zu werden.

glosses: untertänig, sich selbst erniedrigend um etwas bitten

examples.text: „Nein, viel lieber noch hätte er seine Fäuste in ihre Gesichter gehämmert, bis beide nur noch wimmernd und um Gnade winselnd vor ihm gelegen hätten.“

translations.source_sense_description: fiepende, jammernde, leise Töne des Unbehagens von sich geben

glosses: To cry or sob softly and intermittently.

examples.text: The lonely puppy began to whimper as soon as we left the room.
At the sight of Mr. Utterson, the housemaid broke into hysterical whimpering; and the cook, crying out "Bless God! it's Mr. Utterson," ran forward as if to take him in her arms.

glosses: To cry with a low, whining, broken voice; to whine; to complain.

examples.text: Was ther euer yet prechers, but ther wer gainſayers? that ſpurned? that winſt? that whimpered againſt him?

glosses: To say something in a whimpering manner.

examples.text: “Master, please don’t punish me!” he whimpered.

Stripped of all bravado, Cersei breaks, and shows the very scared, vulnerable woman who has kept her emotions at bay. “I don’t want to die,” she whimpers, “Not like this.” It’s all the more moving for coming from a character who built her identity on steely resolve and contempt for such hoary conceits as fear.

translations.source_sense_description: fiepende, jammernde, leise Töne des Unbehagens von sich geben

glosses: A long-drawn, high-pitched complaining cry or sound.

examples.text: The 18-year-old [Justin] Bieber can’t quite pull off the “adult” thing just yet: His voice may have dropped a bit since the days of “Baby,” but it still mostly registers as “angelic,” and veers toward a pubescent whine at times.
I need to have a quick whine about my boss before we start talking about the holiday.
Eighner, in particular, is infamous for his "what publishers and editors did to poor me" whines.

glosses: To make a sound resembling such a cry.

examples.text: The jet engines whined at take off.

glosses: To complain or protest with a whine (compare whinge) or as if with a whine.

examples.text: [S]he was one of your ſoft ſpoken, canting, whining hypocrites, who with a truly jeſuitical art, could wreſt evil out of the moſt inoffenſive thought, word, look or action; […]
Feel awfully about Scott... I always knew he couldn't think—he never could—but he had a marvelous talent and the thing is to use it—not whine in public.

glosses: To move with a whining sound.

examples.text: The jet whined into the air.
The wind whined and moaned through the trees.

glosses: To utter with the sound of a whine.

examples.text: The child whined all his complaints.
Kelly Queen was whining that the boss made him put on his tie.
